scope: Three lookup-only captureBody scratch maps switched from std::map to fixed LLVM DenseMap; null-safe lookup helper and strict existing typed-mask checks
method: Read complete exact diff, entire captureBody producer/register-use consumption, old source map creation, existing product/cap context, and fixed installed SDK DenseMap lookup/insertion/pointer traits. No compiler, Cargo/test execution, benchmark, new test plan, source mutation or commit by reviewer.

conclusions.conclusion: Fixed SDK DenseMap.doFind only checks occupied bits, hashes pointer integer representation and compares pointer equality. DenseMapInfo pointer traits do not dereference keys and have no empty/tombstone reserved values. captureFind explicitly rejects null. Thus foreign/~0/~1 cannot become fabricated ordinals; they miss unless an identical actual key exists. Duplicate try_emplace retains original value, matching old emplace behavior.

IRBlocks and Blocks assign ordinals while visiting original IR/MF ranges, before insertion; not from hash iteration. Operands assigns global original MI ordinal and local operand position while visiting actual instructions. All three maps are used only through insertion/size/find/end and never iterated. Product blocks/MI/operands remain original producer order; register-use result retains std::map key iteration plus original MRI.reg_operands chain order, followed by unchanged coverage count. No use-def order or output Eq field is dropped.

Only scratch container representation changed. All existing Charge calls, flat pool ranges, record payload sizes, shared AU/trace bounds, retained accounting, current owner checks and replay/MIR/MachineVerifier consumers remain unchanged. Scratch allocator capacity can differ and is not covered by logical product/RSS claims. This does not remove full walks or establish net speedup.

Existing explicit scratch typed-mask path now checks null/foreign/all-ones/all-ones-minus-one misses and duplicate insertion with original0/1/2 numbering. Failure still withholds the existing full mask; no assertion is weakened or replaced with a wall-time threshold.
